limitations: Machine ASR establishes sequence/timing, not human wording verification.
No official deck or recording frames inspected; original tables do not attest unseen talk diagrams.
Baydin inspected PDFpages1,4,11–14; page13 table visually inspected; not full-paper review. Rumelhart1986 four scanned pages visually read; only equations7–8 and scoped limitations used.
Stipulated normalized delivery case is not measured robotics evidence.
Smooth finite-graph/quadratic guarantees are in real arithmetic; program uses finite binary64 rounding.
No deployment-generalization, causal, robot-safety or universal optimizer-ranking claim.
Human keyboard/screen-reader audit and root reader integration/render validation remain separate.
